# iosxe_vrrp_ipv6 (Data Source)

This data source can read the VRRP IPv6 configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_vrrp_ipv6" "example" {
  type     = "Vlan"
  name     = "123"
  group_id = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) VRRP group number
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Interface type

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `ipv6_link_local` (String) IPv6 link-local address
- `ipv6_prefixes` (Attributes List) IPv6 prefix addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_prefixes))
- `ipv6_primary` (Boolean) Mark address as primary IPv6 address
- `preempt_delay_minimum` (Number) Seconds to delay before preempting
- `priority` (Number) Priority level
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the VRRP group
- `timers_advertise` (Number) Advertisement interval in milliseconds
- `tracks` (Attributes List) Object tracking configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracks))

<a id="nestedatt--ipv6_prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6_prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `prefix` (String) IPv6 prefix


<a id="nestedatt--tracks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracks`

Read-Only:

- `decrement` (Number) Decrement value for tracked object
- `object_id` (String) Specify the tracked object-id
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown group when tracked object goes down
